sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of water used for different purposes in six areas of the world. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Governments should spend money on railways rather than roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge of experience. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
